capabilities.body: OpenAmer irategura igikorwa, ikagikora ikoresheje ibikoresho nyavyo — aho kwandika amabwirizwa, mucukumbuzi, amadosiye, kode — ikabika ivyagenze neza.
capabilities.title: Umufasha yiyumvira hamwe nawe

capabilities.body: Ibiyago, ivyibukwa n’imideli biguma kuri iyi mashini. Nta kirungikwa utabisavye.
capabilities.title: Imashini yawe, amakuru yawe

capabilities.body: Indimi 186, rumwe rwose mu nyandiko usanzwe usoma. Igice ca mbere c’iyi porogarama kikubaza urwo ushaka.
capabilities.title: Ururimi rwawe, uko bikwiye

capabilities.body: Ubuhinga bubikwa buvuye mu bikorwa nyene, bigatuma ibikorwa vya misi yose vyihuta uko urushiriza kuyikoresha.
capabilities.title: Ubushobozi bugenda burakura

help: Suzuma ko iyi mashini ishobora kuja kuri internet.
Subira gutanguza itunganywa — intambwe zaheze ntizisubirwamwo.
Binanse kabiri, fungura inyandiko z’ibikorwa; imirongo ya nyuma yerekana intambwe yanse.
failure.lead: Nta mahinduka yasubijwe inyuma mu mpisho — OpenAmer ihagarara aho yari igeze, ku buryo uyisubiyemwo ibandanya aho.
failure.leadUpdate: OpenAmer iracari kuri verisiyo ya kera kandi irabandanya gukora. Nta casubirijwe igice gusa.
failure.title: Itunganywa ntiryarangiye

language.lead: Itunganywa ribandanya mu rurimi uhitamwo hano. Urashobora kuruhindura mu nyuma muri porogarama.
language.title: Hitamwo ururimi rwawe

progress.lead: Itunganywa rikorwa rimwe gusa: OpenAmer iriko irakurura ivyo ikeneye yongera itunganya iyi mashini. Niwayifungura mu nyuma, ivyo vyose ntibizosubirwamwo.
progress.leadUpdate: OpenAmer iriko irasubirira verisiyo ya kera. Ibiringo vyawe, ivyibukwa n’amahitamwo biguma uko biri.
progress.title: Gutunganya OpenAmer

stages.rebuild: Gusubira kwubaka porogarama yo kuri mudasobwa
stages.venv: Gukora ikibanza ca Python gitandukanye n’ibindi

cards.body: Fungura porogarama usigure ivyo ushaka ko bikorwa. OpenAmer ikorera mu nyuma ikakumenyesha ivyavuyemwo.
cards.title: Tanguza iryungane

cards.body: Amahitamwo → Imyiyerekano → Ururimi. Indimi 186, ushobora kuzihindura igihe cose.
cards.title: Hitamwo ururimi rwawe

cards.body: Igikorwa gisubirwamwo kivamwo ubuhinga — ubutaha gisaba itegeko rimwe gusa.
cards.title: Reka yibuke

success.command: canke uyitangurize mu nyuma aho kwandika amabwirizwa:
success.errorTitle: Ntivyashobotse gutanguriza porogarama yo kuri mudasobwa
success.lead: Vyose biratunganye. OpenAmer ubu ni iyawe — kuri iyi mashini, mu rurimi rwawe.
success.title: OpenAmer iriteguye

bullets: Ikorera kuri iyi mashini — ibiyago vyawe biguma kuri yo
Vyose birashobora guhindurwa mu nyuma; nta kidahinduka
welcome.lead: Umufasha wawe bwite. Ku mashini yawe. Mu rurimi rwawe.
welcome.leadUpdate: Verisiyo nshasha ya OpenAmer iriteguye. Isubirira iya kera ikazigama ibiringo vyose n’amahitamwo yose.
welcome.note: Bifata iminota mikeyi kuri internet isanzwe.
welcome.title: Kaze muri OpenAmer
